headline: South Korea probes AI-assisted cyberattacks on banks
summary: South Korean authorities are investigating a series of cyberattacks on financial institutions suspected of involving AI, with the president citing signs AI was used and about 25,000 customers' data exposed. CrowdStrike separately reported finding a possible attacker's CV, naming specific AI tools used in the attacks.

claims.statement: South Korean authorities are investigating cyberattacks on financial institutions suspected of involving AI.

sources.quote: South Korea probes bank breaches amid suspected AI-powered attacks

claims.statement: South Korea's president told his cabinet there were signs AI was used to carry out the attacks.

sources.quote: South Korean president Lee Jae Myung told his cabinet that there were signs that hackers used AI to execute the attacks on the banks.

claims.statement: The attacks exposed data from about 25,000 customers.
CrowdStrike reported finding a possible attacker's CV among exposed AI logs, tied to the use of Claude Code and an agentic pentesting tool called ARTEX.
